{
  "dataset_name": "kr_vs_kp",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "gemini-3.1-pro-preview",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "black_king_threat_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Aggregates various boolean indicators related to the black king's position and threats into a single continuous score.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 8.0],
      "feature_family": "composite_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a smooth, monotonic feature for the linear SVM to weigh the overall vulnerability of the black king.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(bkblk == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(bknwy == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(bkon8 == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(bkona == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(bkspr == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(bkxbq == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(bkxcr == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(bkxwp == 't', 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "white_king_position_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sums multiple boolean flags indicating favorable positioning and control by the white king.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "composite_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Creates a continuous severity measure of the white king's positional strength, aiding the SVM in finding a clear margin.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(wkcti == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(wkna8 == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(wknck == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(wkovl == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(wkpos == 't', 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "rook_effectiveness_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Combines several boolean features that describe the rook's mobility, safety, and attacking potential.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 6.0],
      "feature_family": "composite_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Reduces dimensionality of categorical rook features into a single numeric score, improving linear separability.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(r2ar8 == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(reskd == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(reskr == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(rimmx == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(rkxwp == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(rxmsq == 't', 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "special_tactics_count",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Counts the presence of specific tactical motifs such as skewers, checks, and discovered attacks.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 6.0],
      "feature_family": "count",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Acts as a weighted composite of tactical opportunities, allowing the linear model to assign a single coefficient to tactical complexity.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(skewr == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(skach == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(skrxp == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(thrsk == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(dsopp == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(hdchk == 't', 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "pawn_control_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Computes the ratio of black's control over the pawn to the rook's control over the pawn, smoothed by a constant.",
      "value_range": [0.5, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Ratios are highly effective for linear models to capture interactions between opposing forces without requiring non-linear kernels.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.where(bkxwp == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(blxwp == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + 1.0) / (np.where(rkxwp == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "king_safety_differential",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Calculates the difference between white king safety indicators and black king safety indicators.",
      "value_range": [-2.0, 2.0],
      "feature_family": "difference",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides an approximate linear projection of relative king safety, directly contributing to the decision boundary.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.where(wkovl == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(wkpos == 't', 1.0, 0.0)) - (np.where(bkxbq == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(bkxcr == 't', 1.0, 0.0))"
    },
    {
      "name": "stalemate_risk_indicator",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "A weighted sum of features indicating potential stalemate, simplification, or multiple checks.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 2.0],
      "feature_family": "composite_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Offers a continuous measure of drawish tendencies, helping the SVM penalize positions that might not lead to a decisive outcome.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(stlmt == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(simpl == 't', 0.5, 0.0) + np.where(mulch == 't', 0.5, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "katri_numeric_encoding",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Maps the categorical 'katri' feature (king attack status) to a numeric scale (-1 for black, 1 for white, 0 for neutral).",
      "value_range": [-1.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "encoding",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Transforms a nominal category into an ordinal numeric feature, which is natively supported by linear SVMs.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(katri == 'w', 1.0, np.where(katri == 'b', -1.0, 0.0))"
    },
    {
      "name": "dwipd_numeric_encoding",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Converts the 'dwipd' categorical feature (distance of white king to intersection point) into a binary numeric format.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "encoding",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Allows the linear model to directly use this distance proxy as a numeric weight in the margin calculation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(dwipd == 'g', 1.0, 0.0)"
